name: Human

effects.name: Resourceful
effects.description: You gain Heroic Inspiration whenever you finish a Long Rest.

effects.name: Skillful
effects.description: You gain proficiency in one skill of your choice (see Species Skills).

effects.name: Versatile
effects.description: You gain an Origin feat of your choice (record it in the Feats section).

description: A versatile and ambitious people with broad potential across every calling. Skillful grants one skill proficiency of your choice; Versatile grants an Origin feat of your choice; you also learn two additional languages of your choice.
